completion_data.completion_summary: Created lint-contract-compliance.sh (24 static hard-mode contract checks), extended validate-wiring.sh with hard-mode system validation, extended validate-artifact.sh with hard-mode plan H8 section checks, and created validate-handoff.sh for orchestrator handoff JSON schema validation.

memory_candidates.content: Bash arithmetic counters with set -euo pipefail: ((counter++)) when counter=0 evaluates ((0)) which is falsy and exits 1. Use counter=$((counter + 1)) instead. This bug affects validate-artifact.sh and lint scripts that use ((PASSED++)) etc. when the first check passes.

Hard-mode plan detection in validate-artifact.sh: gate detection on H1 title containing '--hard', metadata fields referencing 'planner-hard-agent'/'skill-planner-hard', or explicit '**Effort Mode**: hard' -- not body text -- to prevent false positives on plans that describe or discuss hard-mode without being hard-mode plans themselves.
